Name: Endless Museum
Author: mushymato
Description:
[size=6][b]EndlessMuseum[/b][/size]
Add a new museum display room of arbitrary size, always large enough to fit everything you need to donate.
The new display room's decor changes randomly, it might be haunted.

NOTE: This room does not appear if you do not require more donate slots than you have!

Aside from the display room, this mod also makes sure your donated artifacts are not left out of bounds.

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and install to the Mods folder.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]Enable Glass[/font]: Add glass case to the new displays similar to SVE[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Base Origin[/font]: Top left position of the new museum room, calculated from the bottom edge of the map[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Door Position[/font]: Where to put door that goes to the new room[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Min Room Width[/font]: Minimum width of the room, used if this is greater than the map's width[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]Min Slot Count[/font]: Ensure that the display room has at least this many slots
[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Translations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]English[/*]
[*]简体中文[/*]
[*]Русский (by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ellatuk]ellatuk[/url])[/*]
[/list]
